# Tenants10

> AI-native property and facility management platform for Switzerland,
> available in English, German, French and Italian.

Tenants10 connects buildings, contracts and tenants in one platform: AI
reads contracts and links them to properties/units/tenants automatically,
and gives tenants a self-service app. Hosted in Switzerland.
